limitations: This build (0.1.0-dev.2) was booted only in an emulator. A full system upgrade (229 packages) separates it from the build tested on the laptop.
None of the new file handlers has been tested on real sample files on the laptop.
RAR is extract-only (UnRAR licence). Wine, Waydroid and QEMU are not included.

Screen brightness keys change the on-screen indicator but not the panel brightness; battery level, charging state and power management are not working or not verified; audio, camera, USB-C power delivery, suspend and GPU acceleration are not claimed.
Touchpad works in basic mouse mode only (polling driver).
Boot loader and kernel images are unsigned; Secure Boot must be off. The downloads are signed (SHA256SUMS.asc).
No vendor firmware is included. Default live accounts are those of the development image (user live, password live).
Arch Linux ARM publishes no explicit redistribution statement; the maintainer acceptance of the three-year written source offer is recorded at release approval.
